## Pull Request Description

### Linked Issue Key(s)
Fixes # (e.g. `fixes PM-142` or `refs PM-100`)

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Workflow / Project Automation Rule update

### Verification & Test Coverage
- [ ] Automated tests added/passed (`npm test`)
- [ ] Circular dependency graph validated (`node scripts/validate-circular-dependencies.js`)
- [ ] WIP limit & role transition rules verified
